title: UnifiedTaskParticipant - Data API
description: Represents a participant in a task. This object is available for reports and dashboards in the Winter ’24 release and later.

ActivityId.description: ID of the activity the person is participating in. This field is a relationship field.

ChannelAddress.description: Username of the participant. The username is captured at the time of the communication; it doesn’t change if the contact’s username is updated later.

ParticipantType.description: The participant’s role in the activity. Possible values are: AssignedTo Attendee BCC CC From OptionalAttendee Organizer To

PersonId.description: ID of the contact, lead, or user participating in the activity. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.
